section_job.evidence: The opening sentence performs exactly the approved job: 'คณะที่ปรึกษาแบ่งข้อเสนอแนะในหัวข้อนี้ออกเป็น 2 กลุ่มตามลักษณะของงาน ไม่ใช่ตามช่วงเวลาก่อนหลัง' followed by two clearly headed tracks and a dedicated overlap paragraph, matching the contract's section_job exactly with no drift into §4.3-level technical elaboration.

audience_decision_value.evidence: Every paragraph is framed as what the executive/policy owner must decide or instruct (what to put in TOR70, what กรม สส. must do itself, and to start both now), not as a record of consultant workflow.

evidence_payload.evidence: The Agile argument (para 2 of Track 1) contains claim ('ควรนำกรอบ Agile มาใช้'), mechanism (iterative MVP release and feedback), consequence (risk of a costly unusable system discovered only at final acceptance), and concrete response (>=2 iterations, mid-contract UAT milestone) all in one connected unit.

causal_logic.evidence: The Agile paragraph's 'แนวทางนี้ดีกว่า...เพราะลดความเสี่ยง...ซึ่งเป็นจุดที่แก้ไขได้ยากและมีค่าใช้จ่ายสูงที่สุด' correctly sequences claim before reason before consequence; the overlap paragraph correctly separates buildable artifact (contractor-owned) from institutional process (กรม สส.-owned) without reversing which actor owns which action.

reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: No evidence codes, slide locators, or file paths appear in the prose; the only structural marker is the single required figure placeholder ('ภาพประกอบที่ 1: แผนภาพแสดงสองกลุ่มข้อเสนอแนะ...'), which is a required_structures item, not leaked metadata.

terminology_agency.evidence: Department shorthand 'กรม สส.' is used consistently throughout with no bare 'กรมฯ' or 'สส.'; 'คณะที่ปรึกษา' is the consistent subject of every recommendation verb ('คณะที่ปรึกษาเสนอให้...', 'คณะที่ปรึกษาเห็นควรเน้นย้ำ...'), and 'ผู้รับจ้าง' vs 'กรม สส.' are never substituted for each other in the overlap paragraph.

source_fidelity.evidence: The 5 named products (3 existing: spatial risk DB, hazard/exposure maps, CRI; 2 new: A-BTR, disaster loss-statistics) match verbatim against 'Illustrative platform strategy: build the platform through five real products' in the TOR70 storyline doc; the Track 2 governance list (Data Owner/Data Steward, Governance Committee, metadata/CDM/glossary ratification, asset registry survey) matches FGD3 slide 22-23's 6-month recommendations. One minor overspecification: the draft's 'Data Owner ระดับผู้อำนวยการกอง' asserts a specific org level not stated in the source (slide 17 defines Data Owner generically as 'ผู้บังคับบัญชาตามสายงาน'; slide 18 assigns ownership at กลุ่มงาน level, not named as กอง-level directors) — logged as a minor finding, does not change governing meaning.

form_readability.evidence: Two clearly headed tracks plus a short overlap paragraph and one figure placeholder — prose-first shape appropriate to an executive synthesis; no misapplied ban on lists and no oversized bureaucratic table.

altitude.evidence: No calendar/Gantt structure or budget table appears (both excluded per contract); A-BTR and disaster loss-statistics are named only, with no MVP-sequencing or partner detail, consistent with the exclusion deferring that to §4.3.

headline_conclusion.evidence: The governing decision is stated in the very first paragraph without requiring reconstruction: 'กรม สส. ควรเริ่มทั้งสองกลุ่มพร้อมกันทันที เพราะกลุ่มที่สองต้องดำเนินไปคู่ขนานตลอดระยะเวลาของสัญญาก่อสร้างระบบตั้งแต่วันแรก.'

findings_over_process.evidence: The section states institutional stakes and required decisions (what must go in the TOR, what กรม สส. alone must do) throughout; it never describes how the consultant conducted analysis or reviewed sources.

findings.location: ภารกิจธรรมาภิบาลข้อมูล... section, sentence 1: 'แต่งตั้ง Data Owner ระดับผู้อำนวยการกองและ Data Steward ประจำกลุ่มงาน'
findings.issue: The draft specifies 'ระดับผู้อำนวยการกอง' (Division Director level) for the Data Owner role; the traced source (FGD3 slide 17-18) defines Data Owner generically as the chain-of-command supervisor and assigns ownership at กลุ่มงาน (work-group) level, without naming a กอง-director level specifically.
findings.disposition: Minor overspecification that does not contradict or change the governing recommendation (that a named, accountable Data Owner role must exist); flagged for human review rather than blocking merge.
